name: ELEVATOR PANIC ~Misshitsu no Inkou~
original_name: エレベーターパニック～密室の淫行～
source:
Main character works as a night guard. He watches OL working overtime and returning late from work every day. He decides to have some action and locks himself together with one such woman in the elevator. With escape ways cut out, he is the one to control the situation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
